Bangladesh Gazette: This document is an official publication of the Bangladesh Gazette, which is used by the government to disseminate statutory notifications.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance is the government authority responsible for issuing this customs-related notification.

এস, আর, ও নং ৩৬২/আইন/২০১৫/৬২/কাস্টমস—Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969), অতঃপর উক্ত Act বলিয়া উল্লিখিত, এর section 18 এর sub-section (2) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, উক্ত Act এর FIRST SCHEDULE ভুক্ত পণ্যের মধ্যে নিম্নবর্ণিত TABLE এর কলাম (1) এ উল্লিখিত Heading এর বিপরীতে কলাম (2) তে উল্লিখিত H.S Code এর আওতাধীন কলাম (3) তে বর্ণিত পণ্যের উপর ১০% হারে Regulatory Duty (RD) আরোপ করিল, যথা :-

“TABLE


| Heading No.
(1) | H.S Code
(2) | Description
(3) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10.06 | 1006.20.00 | Husked (brown) rice |
|  | 1006.30.10 | Fortified rice kernels |
|  | 1006.30.90 | Other semi-milled or wholly-milled rice, whether or not polished or glazed |
|  | 1006.40.00 | Broken rice |
”|

Customs Act 1969: This Statutory Regulatory Order is issued under the authority of section 18, sub-section (2) of the Customs Act 1969, which empowers the government to impose regulatory duties on imported goods.
Regulatory Duty: A regulatory duty at the rate of ten percent is imposed on specific rice products imported under the headings and H.S. codes listed in the table.
First Schedule: The goods subject to this regulatory duty are those specified within the First Schedule of the Customs Act 1969.
H.S. Code: The regulatory duty applies to specific varieties of husked, semi-milled, wholly-milled, and broken rice categorized under the specified H.S. codes in the table.
